title: Campaign Build Manager
description:
Company Description

VodafoneThree: Campaign Build Manager - AEP

Location: Newbury + ( Hybrid/ Homebased Working)
Salary: Excellent basic salary plus bonus and Three benefits
Working Hours: Full time 37.5 hours per week - Monday to Friday - core hours between 10.00am and 4.00pm
Duration: Permanent

Hybrid
We believe that through collaboration and connection with our colleagues we can achieve great things. Our hybrid working approach allows our people to work both in the office and at home, providing the flexibility and resources you need to succeed in your role. We don't require you to be in on specific days; instead, we ask people to come into the office 2-3 days each week. You should work with your line manager to understand what their expectations are for you, your specific role and your team.

Who We Are

We're here to build a network the UK can count on - one that connects people, places and potential. Because no matter where you live, what your background is, or how you get online - we think everyone deserves the same chance to stay connected, and with VodafoneThree, that future's being built - today.

We're creating more than the UK's best network. We're helping close the digital divide, empower communities and drive meaningful progress.

We believe that everyone should feel they belong. Whoever you are and whatever your story, there's space for you here. We're building a workplace where different perspectives are welcomed, voices are heard, and everyone feels safe to show up as themselves.

You'll join a team that genuinely cares - about each other, about our customers, and about the future we're building. From day one, you'll be welcomed, valued and encouraged to bring your whole self to work.

Why VodafoneThree

Join us and you'll be at the heart of change. That means building responsibly, investing sustainably and creating opportunities that last.

We're not just expanding connectivity; we're reimagining what a connected nation looks like. With £11bn invested in 5 G and digital infrastructure, your work will directly power businesses, services, and communities across the country.

You'll work on real challenges, with real impact, across every corner of the country. Wherever you join us, whatever your role, you'll be helping to build a future that works better for everyone.

We move at pace, because what we're building matters - and we're learning as we go. We're proud of the progress we've made, but we're just getting started.

Job Description

Are you passionate about customer data, journey orchestration, and cutting-edge martech? We're looking for an experienced Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) Specialist to lead the design, implementation, and optimisation of data-driven experiences using Adobe's Real-Time CDP and Journey Optimiser.

In this pivotal role, you'll translate business needs into scalable AEP solutions, ensuring data integrity, technical excellence, and best-practice execution. You'll also help shape our internal capability, mentor others, and drive continuous improvement across our AEP delivery.

Responsibilities
- Leading end-to-end implementation and optimisation of Adobe Experience Platform solutions, including Real-Time CDP and Adobe Journey Optimiser
- Translating business requirements into scalable, actionable AEP use cases
- Designing and managing XDM schemas, datasets, merge policies, and identity configurations to enable accurate data capture and segmentation
- Integrating AEP with external systems using APIs and other methods to ensure performance, scalability, and efficiency
- Monitoring and optimising data flows through testing, analytics, and performance tuning
- Acting as a trusted advisor to stakeholders-challenging, guiding, and aligning technical delivery with business goals
- Providing technical leadership and mentoring to junior developers to grow internal expertise
- Defining and documenting processes, standards, and QA frameworks to ensure consistent, high-quality delivery
- Staying ahead of Adobe's evolving roadmap and best practices to drive innovation and value

Qualifications
- Expertise in Adobe Experience Platform: Proven hands-on experience with Real-Time CDP, Journey Optimiser, and translating Adobe Campaign Classic into AEP solutions.
- Data architecture and integration: Strong grasp of XDM schemas, identity services, APIs, and data governance, with proficiency in SQL and platforms like Snowflake.
- Stakeholder and team leadership: Skilled in managing expectations, influencing decisions, and mentoring team members to build technical capability.
- Process and quality excellence: Experience defining documentation standards, QA frameworks, and scalable processes for digital marketing and data projects.
- Agile delivery: Comfortable working in agile environments using tools like Jira and Confluence to drive collaboration and efficiency.

Worried that you don't meet all the desired criteria exactly?

We know that everyone is unique, with multiple aspects to their identity and different experiences behind them. We are passionate about Inclusion for All and creating a workplace where everyone can thrive, whatever their personal or professional background. If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align exactly with every part of the job description or you require a more flexible working pattern, we encourage you to apply as you may be the right candidate for this role or another role, and our recruitment team can help you see how your skills fit in.

Additional Information

What we offer

We care about our people's success by offering great pay, bonuses, up to 28 days off plus bank holidays, and paid 'personal' days for moments that truly matter (pro-rata). You can personalise our benefits for you and your family, like discounts, vouchers, a pension plan and loads more. We help with your career through our amazing learning & development tools.

Need to know

We are regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority and all offers of employment for this role are subject to background checks, including criminal (DBS) and financial checks to meet the regulators standards.

We believe everyone should have the opportunity to interview for a role that matches their skills. In collaboration with our Talent, Diversity & Inclusion teams and our employee-led DEI Networks, we identified a range of reasonable adjustments to help you feel comfortable and perform at your best self during the interview process. If you require any reasonable adjustments or have an accessibility request as part of your recruitment journey, for example, extended time or breaks in between online assessments, a sign language interpreter, or assistive technology, please contact your recruiter directly or email for guidance.

We use AI in different parts of our business to boost innovation, improve efficiency, and create new opportunities. We know many candidates use AI to fine-tune their CVs or prepare for interviews, but what we really care about is your unique experiences and achievements.

During the interview, we want you to rely on your own knowledge and skills to show us who you really are-your personality, creativity, and abilities. Above all, we're looking for authenticity and can't wait to get to know the real you.

title: Digital Marketing Executive
description:
Digital Marketing Executive - Global Brand, HYBRID!
Are you looking for the first step in your marketing career? If you are enthusiastic and passionate about Digital Marketing we would love to talk to you! NOW is your chance.
THE OPPORTUNITY:
- Our client is based in Bracknell and is looking for a Digital Marketing Executive to join their team on an on-going temporary basis.
- This is a unique opportunity to gain experience working with a team of 30+ innovative marketers for a global organisation.
- The successful candidates will become experts in global and regional campaigns, content management and regularly update the content on the websites.
- To be considered all you need is a genuine interest in Digital Marketing and a willingness to learn.

JOB TITLE: Digital Marketing Executive
CONTRACT: Temporary, ongoing
HOURS: 09.00 am - 17.30 pm, Monday to Friday
START: ASAP
PAY RATE: 13.00 per hour
LOCATION: Bracknell, Berkshire
RESPONSIBILITIES:
- You will become an expert in global and regional campaigns, content management systems (CMS) and manage all changes on the websites.
- You will be supporting the team with the following activities:
- Small and large scale rollouts of content across 150 country sites
- Some ad hoc technical testing as part of release cycles, and deployments
- Support the orchestration of translation workflows via our translations tool with our translation teams and stakeholders
- Provide site wide SEO support to ensure the site remains high on search results
- Ensuring that all company standards are maintained and changes are compliant to guidelines
- Interacting with a range of stakeholders of different seniorities
- Supporting with UX topics and analysis where required

SKILLS, EXPERIENCE & REQUIRED ATTRIBUTES:
- Ideally you would be a recent graduate with a marketing/business-related degree or marketing experience, preferably Digital Marketing but this is not essential
- Interested and building around AI
- Some HTML and CSS experience/knowledge would be ideal however not essential
- You will have a keen interest and understanding of Digital Marketing
- Microsoft Office and Outlook understanding is essential
- You show great attention to detail, enthusiasm & willingness to learn
- A good team player and you are adaptable to change
- Present excellent communication and organisational skills

If this sounds like an ideal opportunity for you to develop your Digital Marketing career, please get in touch!

Huntress Search Ltd acts as a Recruitment Agency in relation to all Permanent roles and as a Recruitment Business in relation to all Temporary roles.

We practice a diverse and inclusive recruitment process that ensures equal opportunity for all we work with, irrespective of race, sexual orientation, mental or physical disability, age or gender. As an organisation, we encourage applications from all backgrounds and will ensure measures are met when required, to allow a fair process throughout.

PLEASE NOTE: We can only consider applications from candidates who have the right to work in the UK.

title: Graduate Marketing Executive
description:
Marketing Graduate - AI & Digital

Full Time Permanent

We're looking for a Marketing or Software Engineering graduate who is digitally minded, AI-focused and keen to build a career in B2 B marketing.

You'll work across a varied marketing function, gaining experience in content, campaigns, digital, social media, data, lead generation and AI automation.

Key Responsibilities
- Use AI tools to research markets, competitors, target accounts and prospects.
- Support prospecting, outbound campaigns, lead nurturing and account-based marketing.
- Create and repurpose content including social posts, emails, blogs, guides and case studies.
- Support website updates, SEO, paid search, paid social and email campaigns.
- Plan and report on social media activity.
- Assist with campaigns, webinars, events, trade shows and partner marketing.
- Maintain Salesforce data and support campaign tracking and reporting.
- Research customer, competitor, energy market and sustainability information.
- Test AI tools and create simple automations, workflows and prompt libraries.
- Support internal communications, sales enablement, marketing administration, budgets and suppliers.

About You
- Degree in Marketing or Software Engineering with an interest in marketing/growth, digital, data or business, or equivalent experience.
- Confident using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot or Perplexity.
- Tech-savvy with an interest in learning platforms including Salesforce and LinkedIn.
- Strong written communication skills.
- Organised, curious, proactive and willing to get involved.
- Interested in learning how marketing supports business growth and sales.

Apply now!

title: Marketing & Graphic Design Executive
description:
Marketing & Design Executive
Langley, Berkshire Full-time Office-based
Are you a talented Graphic Designer with a strong marketing mindset who enjoys getting stuck into a wide variety of creative projects?
An ambitious and growing UK product-led brand is looking for a Marketing & Design Executive to join its in-house team and take ownership of a broad range of creative and marketing activity.
This is a genuinely hands-on role where you ll be responsible for producing high-quality work across print, digital, website content, product communications, point-of-sale and advertising.
The Role
Working closely with management, sales and product teams, you ll help ensure the brand is presented consistently, professionally and creatively across every customer touchpoint.
No two days will be the same. You could be:
- Designing a brochure or promotional campaign
- Creating artwork for billboards and outdoor advertising
- Producing digital assets for websites, email campaigns and online advertising
- Updating product ranges and content on the website
- Creating technical specification sheets and product literature
- Preparing artwork for print and external suppliers
- Supporting new product and range launches
- Editing and preparing product photography
- Creating sales presentations and marketing materials
- Supporting exhibitions, showroom events and customer activity
- Working with external agencies, photographers, printers and suppliers

You ll have genuine ownership of the day-to-day creative output and the opportunity to make a visible impact on how the brand develops and grows.
About You
We re looking for someone who combines strong graphic design skills with excellent organisation, attention to detail and commercial awareness.
You ll ideally have:
- Strong graphic design skills and an impressive portfolio
- Excellent knowledge of Adobe InDesign, Illustrator and Photoshop
- Experience producing print-ready artwork
- Experience managing and updating website content
- Experience creating brochures, catalogues or technical/product literature
- Good knowledge of image editing and preparation for web and print
- Exceptional attention to detail, particularly with product codes, measurements and technical information
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects at once
- Excellent written English and communication skills
- The ability to work independently and take projects from brief through to completion

Experience within an in-house design/marketing team, creative agency or product-led business would be beneficial.
What s On Offer
This is an exciting opportunity to join an ambitious, growing business with a strong focus on product design, innovation and colour.
You ll have the opportunity to become an important part of the in-house team, with genuine ownership and visibility across the business.
Rather than being restricted to one area of marketing, you ll work across the full creative spectrum from new product launches and technical literature to brochures, websites and national advertising campaigns.
If you re a creative, commercially minded designer who enjoys variety, works quickly and accurately, and takes real pride in how a brand looks and communicates, we d love to hear from you.

title: Marketing and Communications Co-ordinator
company: Bucks and Berks Recruitment - Agency - Permanent
description:
Location: Theale, Berkshire (Office Based)
Salary: £35,000 + benefits
Hours: 35 hours per week

Are you a creative and organised marketing professional who enjoys managing events, social media, communications, and digital content?

Our client, a respected organisation within the agricultural sector, is seeking a Marketing & Communications Coordinator to join their friendly team based in Theale.

This is a varied, hands-on role offering the opportunity to take ownership of marketing activity, communications, events, publications, and brand promotion while working closely with stakeholders.

This is a fully office based role.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage and produce newsletters, publications, and member communications.
- Oversee website content, SEO activity, and user engagement.
- Manage and grow social media channels including LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube and X.
- Organise and deliver monthly online webinars, including promotion, speaker liaison, presentations, and post-event content.
- Coordinate national events, conferences, exhibitions, and local member meetings.
- Draft press releases, media statements, and marketing materials.
- Develop and implement marketing plans to increase engagement and membership awareness.
- Secure sponsorship opportunities for publications and events.
- Maintain and promote organisational branding across all channels.

Skills/Experience
- Previous experience in marketing, communications, events, or a similar role.
- Strong social media, content creation, and digital marketing skills.
- Excellent written communication and proofreading abilities.
- Highly organised with strong attention to detail.
- Confident working independently and as part of a small team.
- Proactive, enthusiastic, and capable of managing multiple projects.
- Strong IT skills and experience using websites, email marketing, and presentation software.
- Full UK driving licence and willingness to travel occasionally.

Desirable
- Knowledge of or interest in the agricultural sector.
- Experience managing webinars, events, and sponsorship relationships.
- Understanding of SEO and website analytics.

Please note that we will only contact those candidates that we assess as suitable for the positions we have currently available based on their experience, training, and skills. If we do not have anything suitable, we will not keep your CV for more than 30 days.

description:
Slough Hybrid Working Excellent Benefits

Our client, a leading food distributor based in Slough, is looking for a Senior PR Executive to join their growing PR & External Communications team.

From industry-leading innovation and sustainability initiatives to customer success stories and thought leadership, the team plays a key role in shaping the organisation's reputation across the foodservice industry.

This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced communications professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys creating compelling content, delivering impactful campaigns and building strong media relationships.

As Senior PR Executive, you'll be at the heart of a busy press office, helping to drive brand awareness and strengthen the company's position as a trusted and influential voice within the sector. The role offers hybrid working and a fantastic benefits package.

title: Social Media Executive
description:
Our client is a growing and ambitious company working with a diverse portfolio of clients across multiple sectors. They are seeking a creative and organised Social Media Executive to join their team, taking ownership of day-to-day social media activity across a range of client accounts. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys content creation, community management and using data to drive performance.

Company Benefits:
- 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays.
- Additional birthday day off when it falls on a weekday.
- Discretionary annual bonus.
- Benefits package including employer pension contributions and healthcare.
- Professional development support and training budget.
- Friendly and collaborative team environment with regular social events.
- Long-term career progression opportunities.
- Flexibility around appointments and occasional personal commitments.

Key Responsibilities:
- Managing day-to-day social media activity across a portfolio of client accounts.
- Creating and implementing content calendars aligned to client objectives and campaign strategies.
- Writing engaging social media copy and coordinating the creation of visual content across multiple platforms.
- Scheduling and publishing content while ensuring brand consistency and platform best practice.
- Managing community engagement, responding to comments, messages and online interactions.
- Monitoring audience feedback, identifying trends and escalating sensitive issues where required.
- Producing performance reports and providing actionable insights to improve content effectiveness.
- Using data and analytics to optimise content, engagement and overall account performance.
- Supporting client communications, content approvals and campaign delivery.
- Coordinating content creation, photography and video requirements where necessary.
- Collaborating with internal teams to ensure social media activity is integrated into wider marketing initiatives.
- Keeping up to date with social media trends, platform developments and emerging opportunities.

Experience and Skills Requirements
- 2-3 years' experience within a social media, digital marketing or content-focused role.
- Strong copywriting skills with excellent attention to detail.
- Experience managing multiple social media accounts and content calendars.
- Good understanding of major social media platforms and best practices.
- Experience using social media scheduling, management and reporting tools.
- Ability to interpret data and translate performance metrics into actionable recommendations.
- Excellent organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple deadlines.
- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
- Creative, proactive and commercially aware approach.
- Genuine enthusiasm for social media, digital marketing and industry trends.

If you have not been contacted within 5 working days, then unfortunately on this occasion your CV has not been shortlisted.

title: E-Commerce & Merchandising Executive
description:
My well established, dynamic Client is urgently looking for an organised, commercially minded E-Commerce and Merchandising Executive to improve the quality, accuracy and performance of their extensive ecommerce product catalogue.

Managing over 13,000 online SKUs across seven main product categories, alongside more than 20,000 offline products, the chosen Candidate will play a key role in improving product data, online merchandising, customer experience and catalogue management processes.

Working closely with Product Management, Pricing, Development, Content, Marketing and Analytics teams, you will lead agreed projects, improve workflows and use data to identify opportunities for continuous improvement.

Key responsibilities
- Maintain accurate, complete and consistent product information across our ecommerce catalogue.
- Improve product categorisation, search, filters and online product presentation.
- Manage product launches, supplier changes, discontinuations and approved pricing updates.
- Use analytics and customer insights to improve product discovery and purchasing journeys.
- Plan and deliver projects, maintaining a prioritised Jira backlog and coordinating stakeholders.
- Establish quality checks for product updates, imports and website releases.
- Improve efficiency through Excel, PIM tools, automation and AI.
- Monitor catalogue performance and recommend improvements based on data and commercial objectives.

Essential experience:
- Experience managing and improving a large ecommerce product catalogue.
- Practical knowledge of PIM and ecommerce platforms, product feeds and bulk data updates.
- Strong Excel skills, including lookups, PivotTables and Power Query.
- Experience delivering cross-functional projects and improving processes.
- Ability to use analytics to improve product merchandising and customer experience.
- Excellent organisation, attention to detail and communication skills.

Systems and technology

The key platforms include Sales Layer, Feed Optimise, PriceShape, Microsoft Excel, Jira, Adobe Commerce, Google Analytics 4 and Microsoft Clarity. Experience with equivalent systems is welcome.

What success looks like

In your first six months, you will establish a catalogue quality baseline, resolve priority data issues, improve processes and deliver a practical roadmap for ongoing improvements.

Performance will be measured through catalogue accuracy and completeness, update turnaround times, delivery reliability and shared commercial measures such as conversion and average order value.

The opportunity

This is a hands-on role offering the opportunity to take ownership of projects, introduce new technologies and make a measurable difference to our ecommerce operations. You will work collaboratively across the business, reporting initially to the Director of Digital & Technology.

Please send an up to date CV for an immediate response and more information on a fantastic opportunity with a truly great Client.
